phase_name: Finalization Configuration, Identity, and Cross-Agent Hardening
phase_title: Finalization Configuration, Identity, and Cross-Agent Hardening
summary: Hardened three finalization-lifecycle weaknesses exposed by executing 134B.1/134B.2 themselves: no automatic delivery-configuration resolution (governed finalization required manually sourcing a shell environment file); no safe repair tool for stale phase-completion metadata; and an uncorrected single-agent attribution of the original notification flood. Added pcae.core.notification_config, a fail-closed, channel-agnostic configuration resolver wired into pcae.cli.main() so every governed invocation (and subprocess) resolves delivery configuration from a governed local file automatically, with explicit environment always taking precedence; extended test isolation with PCAE_NOTIFY_CONFIG_DISABLE so this new global wiring cannot itself bypass 134B.1/134B.2's isolation. Added pcae phase metadata-repair, a narrow, one-direction, auditable tool syncing stale metadata identity fields from the canonical phase-completion-report.md title, with no git/push dependency -- confirmed the existing repository-transition-validator identity-conflict invariants already fail closed correctly rather than rebuilding them. Corrected the historical incident attribution: reproduced under DeepSeek, Claude, and Codex alike, confirming a PCAE substrate cause, not a DeepSeek-specific one; added cross-agent tests parametrized over four synthetic caller identities and confirmed zero model-identity branches in any lifecycle-critical module. 134C not begun.
